title: Daily Note Template
description: This is a template for daily notes
author: RafaelGB

title: Academic research
description: Academic research, drawn as a flow: one capture asks whether you're taking notes on a source or recording a finding, and branches to a literature note (author, venue, method, claims) or a finding (claim, evidence, tensions) — cross-checked and maturity-scored on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Zettelkasten v2
description: The slip-box, drawn as a flow: one capture asks what kind of note this is and branches to a fleeting, literature or permanent note — each a phased step with its own prompts and a scaffolded body, cross-checked and maturity-scored on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: PARA v2
description: PARA, drawn as a flow: one classify step decides where an item belongs and branches to a Project, Area, Resource or Archive note — each a phased step with its own prompts, dates and a scaffolded body, filed in its PARA folder and connected on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: GTD
description: Getting Things Done, drawn as a flow: one capture clarifies what a thought is and branches to a context-tagged next action, a project with an outcome, or a reference/someday note — each a phased step filed in its GTD folder and connected on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Reading
description: Reading, drawn as a flow: one capture asks whether you're logging a source or writing a note from your reading, and branches to a source card (type, status, link) or a reading note (the idea in your words, a quote, your take) — connected and claim-extracted on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Writing
description: Writing, drawn as a flow: one capture asks where you are — starting a draft, drafting a section, or reviewing — and branches to the matching note (thesis + outline, section points, or a works/fix/next review), phased and connected on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Software architecture KB
description: A software architecture knowledge base, drawn as a flow: one capture asks whether you're recording a decision or a component, and branches to an ADR (context, decision, status, consequences, alternatives) or a component note (responsibility, interfaces, dependencies) — cross-checked on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Meeting notes
description: Meeting notes as one inline step: title, date, attendees, agenda, the notes themselves, decisions and action items — related to the rest of your vault on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Daily journal
description: A daily journal as one inline step: the date, a mood, today's highlights, a line of gratitude and one intention for tomorrow — related to the rest of your notes on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Concept note
description: An evergreen concept note as a single rich step: name it, define it, say why it matters and give an example, stamp a Zettel id, and on creation get it related, cross-checked, maturity-scored and questioned — all in one inline box. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Decision journal
description: A decision journal as one inline step: the decision, its context, the options weighed, your rationale, the outcome you expect and a date to review it — cross-checked on creation so you can learn from it later. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Inquiry
description: An inquiry as one inline step: a question worth your attention, why it matters, what you already know, a provisional response you own, and a next step — related and probed for open questions on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Weekly focus
description: Choose one idea to actually think about this week, picked from the ones that grew without your judgement, and stamp the state of your vault so next week has something to compare against. Uses the scripting API; offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow
